name: Sphinx (Oracle Mystery)
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the sphinx mystery adds Fly, Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (nature), and Perception to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: speak with animals (2nd), blinding ray (4th), shifting sand (6th), beast form ll (lion only)(8th), contact other plane (10th), owl’s wisdom, mass (12th), legend lore (14th), animal shapes (16th), miracle(18th).

Revelations: An oracle with the sphinx mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Emulate Sentinel (Su)

Each time you use this revelation, you can choose any of the sphinxes listed. You can use this revelation 2 times per day. At 11th level, you gain one additional use per day. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Conundrum of the Gynosphinx– As a standard action, you telepathically project a series of befuddling riddles upon the mind of a creature within 30 feet. The target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, the creature is stunned for 3 rounds. On a successful save, the creature gains the confused condition for 1 round instead. Mindless creatures are immune to this ability.
Roar of the Androsphinx– As a standard action, you emit a roar that fills a 60-foot-radius burst centered on you. All foes in the area must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, a creature gains the cowering condition for 1 round and is shaken for 1 minute thereafter. On a successful save, a creature doesn’t cower and is shaken for 1 round instead. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
Shriek of the Hieracosphinx– As a standard action, you emit a shriek that fills a 30-foot-radius burst centered on you. All creatures in the area must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 sonic damage and is deafened for 2d4 rounds.
Expanded Magic (Ex)

When you take this revelation, choose either androsphinx or gynosphinx. You add the associated spells to your list of spells known.

Androsphinx: 1st- remove fear, 2nd- resist energy, 3rd- searing light
Gynosphinx: 1st- comprehend languages, 2nd- see invisibility, 3rd-clairaudience/clairvoyance
Hybrid Anatomy (Su)

As a standard action, you can transform parts of your body into different animals to gain various benefits. This functions exactly as animal aspect, greater, except your transformation lasts for 1 hour each time you use this revelation. You can end your transformation early with a free action, but any remaining duration is immediately expended. You can use this revelation a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Keeping Secrets (Ex)

You are a master at keeping information safe from prying eyes and secret-seekers. Likewise, you can tell when someone isn’t disclosing all the facts. You gain Skill Focus (sense motive) as a bonus feat. At 7th level, you gain immunity to spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities (such as detect anxieties, detect desires, and detect thoughts) that seek to know your thoughts.

Leonine Body (Su)

You can use a standard action to polymorph your lower half (below the waist, similar to a centaur) into a lion, gaining four legs. While polymorphed, your base land speed increases by +10 feet, your CMD against trip attempts increases by +4, and you gain a +4 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks. You can remain in this form for 1 hour per oracle level. You can return to your native form prematurely as a free action, but any unused duration is immediately expended.

Repository Of Knowledge (Ex)

Choose two types of Knowledge skills. You gain a bonus on the chosen skill checks equal to 1/2 your oracle level. At 11th level, you can choose a third type of Knowledge skill to gain this bonus.

Sphinx Senses (Ex)

You gain low-light vision. At 3rd level, you gain darkvision 60 feet.

Visage of the Sphinx (Su)

As a swift action, you can transform your head into the visage of a criosphinx or a hieracosphinx for 1 round. If you choose the criosphinx, you gain the head of a ram, acquiring a natural gore attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage (1d4 for a Small Oracle). If you choose the hieracosphinx, you gain the head of a falcon, acquiring a natural bite attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage (1d4 for a Small Oracle).

These are primary natural attacks that add 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier to damage. If these attacks are used in conjunction with manufactured weapons, they become secondary natural attacks instead which are made at your base attack bonus -5 and add only 1/2 your Strength bonus. You can use this revelation a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Wings (Ex)

You have a pair of wings that wrap around your body, obscuring your anatomy and making it difficult for opponents to target your vital organs. While your wings are wrapped around you, there is a 20% chance that any successful sneak attack or critical hit made against you is turned into a normal hit instead. At 7th level, your wings become strong enough for short bursts of flight. You gain a fly speed of 60 feet with poor maneuverability. At 11th level, you gain your choice of Flyby Attack or Hover as a bonus feat. You can fly a number of minutes per day equal to your oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1- minute increments.

Wisdom Of The Ages (Ex)

You have the mind of a creature that has lived for ages and the wisdom that comes with it.

Wisdom is your spell-casting ability modifier, and anytime Charisma is referenced in a revelation or other oracle class feature, you use your Wisdom instead. At 3rd level, you gain a +1 inherent bonus to Wisdom. This bonus increases by +1 every fourth oracle level gained thereafter (up to a maximum bonus of +5 at 19th level).

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, you take on the eternal nature of sphinxes. You gain all the benefits to your mental ability scores as though you aged two categories without incurring any of the drawbacks to your physical ability scores.

Though you gain these increases to your mental ability scores, your age category doesn’t actually change. Additionally, once per day as a standard action, you can enter a state of final sleep for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier. For the duration, your skin becomes as hard as sandstone, granting you a +4 bonus to your natural armor class and Dr 10/magic.
